tools.name: list_courses
tools.title: List courses
tools.description: List Software Engineer academy courses, optionally filtered by category (Frontend, Backend, AI, CS, Security) or level (Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced).

tools.name: list_roadmaps
tools.title: List learning roadmaps
tools.description: List all learning roadmaps offered by the Software Engineer academy (Frontend, Backend, AI, and more) with their reference URLs.

search.description: Optional keyword to match in the roadmap name (English or Arabic).

tools.name: list_languages
tools.title: List programming languages
tools.description: List programming languages covered by the academy along with difficulty (1-5), estimated learn time, jobs score, and popularity.

max_difficulty.description: Only include languages with difficulty <= this value.
